description_en: Revokes permissions on hosts and host accounts from a user
description_zh: 移除给用户授权的主机及主机账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-host-accounts-from-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --hosts HostId_:_1_,_HostId_:_2_,_HostAccountIds_:_1_,_2_,_3_,_HostId_:_3_,_HostAccountIds_:_4_,_5_,_6_,_HostId_:_4_,_HostAccountIds_:_9_,_8_,_7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachHostAccountsFromUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to revoke permissions on the specified hosts and host accounts from the user.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权主机和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to revoke permissions on the specified hosts and host accounts from the user.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权主机和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user from whom you want to revoke permissions on the specified hosts and host accounts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the user ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权主机和主机账户的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts and host accounts on which you want to revoke permissions from the user. You can specify up to 10 host IDs and up to 10 host account IDs for each host. You can specify only host IDs. In this case, the permissions on the specified hosts and all accounts of the hosts are revoked from the user. For more information about this parameter, see the Description of the Hosts parameter section of this topic.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the host IDs and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466581.html operation to query the host account IDs
parameters.help_zh:
指定要为用户移除授权的主机ID和主机账户ID。最多支持设置10个主机ID，每个主机最多支持设置10个主机账户ID。您可以不设置主机账户ID，不设置主机账户ID表示为用户移除授权主机和该主机的所有授权主机账户。该参数的具体结构请参考请求参数列表下的Hosts参数结构说明。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466581.html接口获取目标主机已授权的主机账户ID
parameters.name: hosts
